title: Quick-Fix Venezuelan Sea Bass Toast
description: A rich and springy Venezuelan dish featuring pan-seared sea bass fillets, served on crispy bread with a zesty sauce.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and place the bread slices on it.
Brush the bread slices with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic powder and paprika.
Season the sea bass fillets with salt and pepper to taste.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add a small amount of oil.
Sear the sea bass fillets for 2-3 minutes per side, until cooked through.
Transfer the sea bass fillets to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same skillet, add the sliced avocado, cucumber, and red onion.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables are lightly charred.
In a small bowl, mix together the lime juice, yogurt sauce, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Serve the sea bass fillets on top of the toasted bread, with the vegetables and yogurt sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves, if desired.
